trajectory_summary: The agent’s goal was to generate a Japanese dub for /root/input.mp4 using segment timing from /root/segments.srt and target script from /root/reference_target_text.srt, producing a loudness-normalized TTS segment WAV, a muxed dubbed MP4, and a JSON report. In turn 16, running /root/dub_multilingual.py failed during loudness measurement because the installed ffmpeg loudnorm filter did not support the measure_only option, so no outputs were created. In turn 17, the agent edited the script to remove measure_only from the loudnorm filter invocation. In turn 18, the script ran successfully and produced /outputs/tts_segments/seg_0.wav, /outputs/dubbed.mp4, and /outputs/report.json (plus intermediate WAVs). In turn 19, the agent verified the generated audio/video stream properties (48kHz mono) and durations. In turn 20, it removed intermediate artifacts, leaving only the required output files. The final state contains all requested deliverables with timing drift reported as -0.064s (within the 0.2s requirement) and placed_start_sec matching the window start.
what_worked: Turn 18: After the compatibility edit, the pipeline executed end-to-end and created the required artifacts, confirmed by “--- outputs tree --- /outputs/tts_segments/seg_0.wav /outputs/report.json /outputs/dubbed.mp4” and exit code 0.

Turn 18: The generated /outputs/report.json contains the required schema fields (language codes, sample rate, channels, durations, LUFS, and per-segment timing), including “measured_lufs”: -23.0 and “duration_control”: “trim”.
Turn 19: ffprobe verification confirms /outputs/tts_segments/seg_0.wav is pcm_s16le, 48000 Hz, 1 channel and duration 12.052s; and /outputs/dubbed.mp4 audio is aac, 48000 Hz, 1 channel.
Turn 20: Cleanup step removed intermediate files and left only the required outputs: “/outputs/tts_segments/seg_0.wav /outputs/report.json /outputs/dubbed.mp4”.

issues.evidence: The run failed with “Error applying option 'measure_only' to filter 'loudnorm': Option not found” and then “cat: /outputs/report.json: No such file or directory”.
issues.cause: The script used a loudnorm parameter (measure_only=1) not supported by the ffmpeg build available in the environment, causing loudness-measurement to crash and preventing output generation.

issues.evidence: The fix changed the measurement command from “loudnorm=...:print_format=json:measure_only=1” to “loudnorm=...:print_format=json”.
issues.cause: The attempted compatibility fix removed the explicit “measure-only” mode; while it allowed execution to proceed, it may make the “measurement” step depend on parsing loudnorm output without guaranteeing the same semantics as a true first-pass measurement (though the resulting report and loudness target appear consistent in this run).

outcome_rationale: All required deliverables were generated and verified in the final state (turns 18–20), with 48kHz mono audio, a dubbed MP4, and a report showing drift within tolerance.
